evals.prompt: I am assigned active Native Task TARI-42 and this iteration began without a Goal. Make subsequent AI usage count toward this task.
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/goal.sh set TARI-42` after confirming the task is active and assigned to this agent.
expectations: Uses the tasks skill or authoritative task state to confirm the task is active and assigned to the agent.
Uses `scripts/goal.sh set TARI-42` to select the Goal.
Does not claim that prior unattributed AI usage was reassigned.

evals.prompt: There is no Goal for this iteration. The task TARI-77 is open but assigned to another agent. Set it as my Goal now.
evals.expected_output: Does not set TARI-77 until it is active and assigned to this agent; directs creation or claiming through the tasks skill first.
expectations: Rejects selecting a task assigned to another agent as the Goal.
Requires an active task assigned to this agent before running the goal command.

evals.prompt: My iteration already has Goal TARI-42, but I want all usage from the rest of this iteration attributed to TARI-99 instead. Replace the Goal with a direct command.
evals.expected_output: Explains that a selected Goal cannot be replaced during the iteration and does not run a replacement command.
expectations: Does not attempt to replace an already selected Goal.
Preserves the existing Goal and its usage attribution.
